tasks.label: Descargar agentes según respuestas Sí/No
tasks.command: $downloads = @(); if ('${input:quieresAgents}' -eq 'Sí') { $downloads += @{Source='.github/agents'; Destination='.github/agents'} }; if ('${input:quieresSkills}' -eq 'Sí') { $downloads += @{Source='skills'; Destination='.github/skills'} }; if ('${input:quieresReadme}' -eq 'Sí') { $downloads += @{Source='README.md'; Destination='.'} }; if ($downloads.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'No has seleccionado nada para descargar.'; exit 0 }; git fetch https://github.com/aimarsanm/python-unit-test-agents.git main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $temp = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString()); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temp | Out-Null; try { foreach ($download in $downloads) { $archive = Join-Path $temp 'download.zip'; git archive --format=zip --output=$archive FETCH_HEAD -- $download.Source; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'No se pudo crear el archivo ZIP desde el repositorio.' }; $expanded = Join-Path $temp 'expanded'; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $expanded -Force; $sourcePath = Join-Path $expanded $download.Source; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sourcePath)) { throw "No se encontró la ruta solicitada: $($download.Source)" }; if ($download.Destination -ne '.') { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $download.Destination -Force | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sourcePath -PathType Container) { Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $sourcePath '*') -Destination $download.Destination -Recurse -Force } else { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $sourcePath -Destination $download.Destination -Force }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $expanded -Recurse -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archive -Force } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
